scope: Full fixed broker and standalone service source read; contract binding checked for the fixed lane and immutable maintenance proof.

Root service loads only the two separately registered, root-owned, mode0400, nofollow, single-link, bounded modules from the fixed service directory. Both hashes are checked before either module compiles, and execution uses the same read bytes.
Standalone broker imports only stdlib and the preloaded pure contract; it does not import service-user-writable Open WebUI application modules.
Unix peer must match the registered Core PID, all real/effective/saved/fs UIDs and GIDs, start ticks before/after, command digest and host boot ID. Proof is repeated at the authenticated challenge.

Broker permits only prepare/execute/observe, fixed socket/key paths, bounded authenticated frames and a fresh request challenge. Root gate and original scope/binding are revalidated; caller input cannot select argv, path, profile or nonce authority.

Fixed controller argv starts the separately owned one-use unit. Root attempt directory, immutable binding and launch intent precede the sole systemd client call. A lost acknowledgement never retries the original unit; existing partial admission is retained.
Accepted launch tasks are shielded and tracked; closure denies new admissions, waits accepted tasks, and removes only its exact owned socket inode. A second service cannot replace an existing socket.
Outcome reads require the fixed root-owned context, nonce, execution-manifest, authority, worker identity, reservation and confirmed cleanup before reporting completion.
limits: This review accepts these source boundaries and correlates existing offline receipts. It is not a service installation, root gate, native authority, nonce, provider verification, deployment or live acceptance.
Protected source/key/registration ownership, live Core process pins, socket directory, unit registration and complete protected controller dependencies require the separate operator preflight.

Kernel identity tests exercise actual self-process metadata; framing tests use actual encoders/decoders on in-memory streams. Root file reads, systemd launch, unknown acknowledgement and shutdown execution remain controlled offline fixtures.

The review covers the two fixed root broker/entrypoint files and their contract interaction; it does not substitute for the owner's full Core/API composition validation or actual native worker/QA acceptance.
